g.title: p1
g.text: P1 — top row, left to right

g.title: p2
g.text: P2 — bottom row, left to right

g.title: legend
g.text: PA0 = D1, the blue LED (active-low); PA0 is also FCC_IN
PA10 / PA11 = CH340X USB-serial bridge (PA10 to RXD, TXD to PA11)
PA19 / PA20 = SWDIO / SWCLK on P3 (not on P1/P2)
PA2 (ROSC) is not broken out at all
